description: Source code for TranscoderWrapper class implementing media transcoding control, including setup, start, pause, resume, stop, and event handling, with callback mechanisms and error reporting within Android media framework.

classes.name: TranscoderWrapper::CallbackImpl
classes.description: Implementation of MediaTranscoder callback interface, forwarding events to TranscoderWrapper.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts an Event object to a string representation.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Reports an error or resource loss to the callback.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a transcoding session with given request parameters.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops a transcoding session, optionally abandoning it.

methods.name: setupTranscoder
methods.description: Configures the media transcoder with source, track formats, and destination.

methods.name: handleStart
methods.description: Handles starting the transcoder after setup.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Resets internal state and releases resources.

methods.name: logSessionEnded
methods.description: Logs the end of a transcoding session.

methods.name: queueEvent
methods.description: Queues an event for processing in the thread loop.
